a1.speaker: acolyte
a1.text: The Master's light is very beautiful. Have you ever seen it? ...No. None of us have.

a2.speaker: acolyte
a2.text: A face, once. He took it for safekeeping. He keeps all our faces.
a2.text_low_hope: Soon you will not need yours either.

late.speaker: acolyte
late.text: The temple hums now. One more light and the door opens. I cannot remember which side of the door I am meant to be on.
